papers.title: Sound-Horizon-Agnostic Forecast for Constraints on $H_0$ and $Σm_ν$ from BAO, CMB Lensing, Supernovae and LSST-like Galaxy Lensing
papers.summary: We present a sound-horizon-agnostic forecast for constraints on the Hubble constant $H_0$ and the sum of the neutrino masses $Σm_ν$ from a combination of LSST-like galaxy weak lensing, Simons-Observatory-like CMB lensing, the completed DESI BAO program, and expanded supernova samples. Treating the sound horizon at baryon drag $r_d$ as a free parameter, the method provides a consistency test of $Λ$CDM without relying on the standard early-Universe calibration of $r_d$. The analysis incorporates realistic galaxy weak-lensing systematics, explicitly marginalizing over photometric-redshift calibration, multiplicative shear biases, intrinsic alignments, and baryonic feedback, and extends the CMB-lensing analysis to $L_{\max}=5000$. For fixed $Σm_ν$, we forecast uncertainties of $σ(H_0)\simeq 1.5$ km/s/Mpc with our least informative prior set, $σ(H_0)\simeq 1.3$ km/s/Mpc with more restrictive priors, and $σ(H_0)\simeq 0.7$ km/s/Mpc with an additional informative prior on the amplitude of primordial fluctuations $A_s$. Allowing $Σm_ν$ to vary weakens the $H_0$ constraints, while still yielding a forecast 95% CL upper limit of about 0.4 eV on $Σm_ν$. We also clarify the scope of the $r_d$-agnostic approach through validation tests using mock data from modified recombination and early dark energy models. The method recovers unbiased constraints on $H_0$ for the former but not the latter, highlighting its dependence on assumptions about early-Universe physics.

papers.title: SpecLess: A Multi Survey Python Package for Machine Learning Classification of Galaxy Morphology and Activity from Photometry
papers.summary: Broad band photometry enables scalable galaxy classification without spectroscopy at inference time, yet strong within survey performance may not transfer when the same galaxies are measured by another survey. We present SpecLess, an open source Python package implementing two photometric classification tasks: high confidence Galaxy Zoo 1 elliptical and spiral morphologies, and four SDSS spectroscopic activity reference classes (starforming, starburst, Seyfert, and LINER). Using SDSS+AllWISE, KiDS+VIKING, and DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys photometry, survey specific XGBoost classifiers achieve held out macro F1 scores of 0.9332 (SDSS; 35,554 galaxies) and 0.9237 (KiDS; 3,269) for morphology, and 0.7637 (SDSS; 16,931) and 0.7398 (DESI; 11,975) for activity. Starforming and starburst references are recovered more effectively than Seyfert and LINER, while feature ablations reveal complementary contributions from optical and mid infrared photometry. We quantify catalogue dependence using separately trained common feature models evaluated on matched galaxies with identical labels and data partitions. Relative to target trained models, macro F1 deficits are 0.0153 (SDSS to KiDS) and 0.0354 (KiDS to SDSS) for morphology (12,301 galaxies; 20 splits), and 0.0660 (SDSS to DESI) and 0.0406 (DESI to SDSS) for activity (11,975 test galaxies). Colour only refits, additive corrections, and optical infrared substitutions reveal direction dependent sensitivity without consistently recovering target trained performance. SpecLess v0.3.0 distributes four pretrained, survey specific classifiers through a unified Python interface. The package provides a reproducible baseline for photometric galaxy classification across multiple surveys while establishing an extensible, open source foundation for future developments in classification methods and photometric catalogue support.

papers.title: A Catalog of Spectral Properties for DESI DR1 Quasars
papers.summary: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) is carrying out a five-year spectroscopic survey designed to map the large-scale structure of the Universe and obtain spectra for millions of galaxies and quasars over a wide redshift range. We present a value-added catalog of spectral properties for 1,717,774 unique quasars (1,774,723 spectra) in the DESI Data Release 1. We perform a uniform spectral decomposition of the quasar continuum, host galaxy emission (at $z<1$), and \FeII\ emission, and measure the line properties of major broad and narrow emission lines from Ly$α$ to H$α$ covered by DESI spectra. We also provide single-epoch black hole mass estimates (from H$β$, \MgII, and \CIV), bolometric luminosities, and Eddington ratios for these quasars. We provide systemic redshifts that account for the intrinsic velocity shifts of individual lines; they agree with the DESI pipeline redshifts to within 500~km s$^{-1}$ for 88.6\% of the sample, and are most useful at $z>1$ where the pipeline redshift is heavily constrained by blueshifted high-ionization lines. We also provide local fits to several optical coronal lines, including \NeV~$\lambda3426$, [\ion{Fe}{7}]~$\lambda5722$, [\ion{Fe}{7}]~$\lambda6088$, and [\ion{Fe}{11}]~$\lambda7893$. We show that several emission-line ratios, including those involving coronal lines, vary systematically with Eddington ratio. The catalog is intended as a community resource for studies of quasar demographics, black hole accretion, emission-line physics, and the connection between the broad-, coronal-, and narrow-line regions.

papers.title: A cosmological intercept tension in local distance ladders
papers.summary: The Hubble tension motivates direct tests of the internal consistency of the local distance ladder. We perform forward and backward consistency checks between Type Ia supernovae in Cepheid host galaxies and the Hubble-flow supernova sample using Pantheon+ data. Within flat $Λ$CDM, we impose Planck-CMB priors on one sample, infer the supernova absolute-magnitude calibration, and propagate it to the other sample to recover the Hubble constant, which should match the input value if the second and third rungs of the distance ladder align perfectly. We examine the impact of host-galaxy peculiar velocities using redshift corrections based on the Manticore-Local reconstruction. These corrections shift the recovered $H_0$ from $74.30^{+1.18}_{-1.20}$ to $71.37^{+1.23}_{-1.18}$ $\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}}$ in the forward analysis and from $60.83^{+0.98}_{-0.97}$ to $63.25^{+0.95}_{-0.93}$ $\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}}$ in the backward analysis, bringing both results closer to the input CMB constraint. Comparing the cosmological intercepts of the magnitude-redshift relation inferred from two rungs of the distance ladder before and after peculiar-velocity corrections, we find that the significance of the discrepancy decreases from $6.8σ$ to $3.9σ$ in the forward check and from $7.3σ$ to $4.3σ$ in the backward check. Peculiar-velocity corrections therefore partially alleviate the intercept tension, while a residual discrepancy persists within the adopted framework. Our results highlight the importance of local velocity modeling and motivate further tests of sample selection and calibration systematics in assessing distance-ladder consistency.

papers.title: Odd radio circle J1555+2726: Observational evidence for shock re-acceleration of fossil plasma
papers.summary: Context. Odd radio circles (ORCs) are peculiar extragalactic sources recently discovered. They are characterised by one or more bright rings extending on scales of hundreds of kiloparsecs, and are filled with fainter emission. A massive elliptical galaxy lies at the centre of ORCs. While their formation mechanism is debated, a shock is plausibly involved. Aims. We aim to constrain the nature of ORC J1555+2726 (ORC4) through the analysis of its morphological and spectral properties. Methods. We utilised Low Frequency ARray (LOFAR), upgraded Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (uGMRT), and MeerKAT radio data at 50-1284 MHz to obtain images and spectral index maps at high resolution and sensitivity. Results. Both the resolution and observing frequency affect the observed morphology. In particular, the brightness contrast between the ring and the filling emission becomes progressively smoother from higher to lower frequencies. We measured an integrated spectrum of slope $α=1.06\pm 0.03$, a radio power of $P_{\rm 150}= (5.4\pm 0.5)\times 10^{25} \; {\rm W \; Hz^{-1}}$ at 150 MHz, and a radial spectral flattening down to $α\sim0.5$ at the ring location. However, we inferred a negative (convex) spectral curvature and a peculiar spectral shape in radio colour-colour diagrams, which imply spectral flattening towards high frequencies. These properties cannot be explained by shock acceleration of thermal particles and standard ageing. Conclusions. The observed features suggest that a mixture of electrons with different spectra coexist within ORC4 volume, likely associated with shock re-acceleration of a fossil relativistic reservoir. The ring emission is plausibly dominated by higher-energy electrons re-accelerated at the shock front, while lower-energy re-accelerated electrons are more uniformly distributed across the whole source (possibly ellipsoidal) volume.

papers.title: QUIJOTE scientific results - XII. Characterization of the polarized synchrotron emission at the power spectrum level in the QUIJOTE-MFI wide survey
papers.summary: We present an analysis of the polarized synchrotron emission at the power-spectrum level in the multipole range $30 < \ell < 130$, using the recent QUIJOTE-MFI wide survey (10-20GHz) in combination with Planck and WMAP data. The EE and BB power spectra are well described by a simple power-law model, with no evidence for the need of additional parameters. The best-fit slopes are $α_{EE} = -3.24 \pm 0.12$ and $α_{BB} = -3.81 \pm 0.34$ for $|b|>20^\circ$, hinting toward a steepening of the BB spectrum relative to EE at the $\sim 1.6σ$ level. The synchrotron frequency spectral indices are found to be $β_s^{EE} = -3.26 \pm 0.05$ and $β_s^{BB} = -3.25 \pm 0.10$ for the same cut, in agreement with earlier real-space analyses. We find no evidence for spatial variations of $β_s$ across different Galactic latitude cuts, within current uncertainties. The synchrotron BB/EE power ratio is approximately 0.2 over the considered multipole range, lower than typical values for thermal dust, and consistent with previous measurements. We also measure a dust-synchrotron spatial correlation in the range 0.1-0.25 over $30 < \ell < 130$. Using these results, we estimate the level of synchrotron contamination in future CMB B-mode measurements, finding an average power in the considered sky masks equivalent to $r \sim 0.003$ at 90GHz and $r \sim 0.0002$ at 150GHz for the relevant angular scales.
papers.summary_zh: QUIJOTE-MFI 偏振同步辐射功率谱：EE/BB 都是单一幂律，α_EE=−3.24±0.12、α_BB=−3.81±0.34。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave Diffractive Images Reveal the Structure of Astrophysical Objects
papers.summary: Scattering patterns encode the structure of extended objects, as demonstrated by charged particle scattering on atomic nuclei. Gravitational wave (GW) diffraction offers an analogous probe of otherwise invisible mass distributions. At linear order in the lens potential we derive expressions relating the central diffractive image contribution to a gravitationally lensed GW waveform to the Fourier transform of the projected lens density. For finite mass lenses this contribution takes the form of a point mass Born amplitude multiplied by a normalized mass form factor, analogous to that in nuclear scattering. As the frequency of GWs from a merging compact binary source evolves the signal samples this form factor across spatial scales, imprinting lens structure through interference with the primary image. Using full numerical wave optics calculations we quantify the observational reach for extended dark matter objects, primordial black holes halo-dressed by dark matter halos and superradiance clouds of ultralight bosons around black holes. For the considered source populations, five year observations with next generation detectors can distinguish extended lenses from point masses, probing dark matter fractions down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-5})$, and halo-dressed primordial black holes from matched bare black holes, probing primordial black hole dark matter fractions down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-6})$. For sufficiently close source-lens configurations, scalar superradiance clouds can produce distinguishable diffraction signatures for boson masses of approximately $10^{-17}-10^{-12}~\mathrm{eV}$. These results provide a framework for characterizing extended dark matter and compact object astrophysical environments.
papers.summary_zh: 引力波衍射像的频率演化编码透镜投影质量分布，给出与核散射质量形状因子类比的理论框架。

papers.title: The XMM-Newton view of the DEM L36 superbubble in the Large Magellanic Cloud
papers.summary: We present the first multi-wavelength analysis of the DEM L36 superbubble in the Large Magellanic Cloud. We compare the DEM L36 superbubble with other Galactic and Magellanic Cloud superbubbles. We use data from XMM-Newton, supplemented by data from the Magellanic Cloud Emission Line Survey, the Dark Energy Camera Magellanic Cloud Emission Line Survey, the Spitzer Space Telescope, and the Australia Telescope Compact Array. We perform a multi-wavelength morphological analysis to understand the shape and structure of the superbubble and X-ray spectral analysis to derive physical parameters of the hot gas. We find significant X-ray emission in DEM L36, dominated by a central bubble region mostly confined by a thin H$α$ filamentary shell. This has two distinct blowout regions to the east and west, with a possible smaller blowout in the south. Spectral analysis shows the X-ray emission is well fit with a thermal plasma model in collisional ionisation equilibrium with a temperature of $kT=0.17~(0.16-0.18)$ keV and unabsorbed luminosity $L_{X~(0.5-7.0~\mathrm{keV})}=3.62\times 10^{35} $erg s$^{-1}$. Unlike other LMC superbubbles, we find no clear powering cluster at the centre, though relatively small clusters near the edge are likely supplying the mechanical input at the present epoch. We use photometric data of these clusters to estimate cluster masses, ages, and mechanical inputs to compare with the energy stored in the superbubble. We find that these clusters have supplied more energy over their lifetime than is currently observed in the superbubble, indicative of the so-called growth rate discrepancy problem. It is likely the DEM L36 superbubble was initially shaped by a central massive stellar population that has since dispersed and largely lost to supernovae, with smaller clusters at the edges of the swept-up shell being currently supplying the energy input.
papers.summary_zh: XMM-Newton 等多波段数据刻画 LMC 的 DEM L36 超级气泡，中心存在显著的热气体 X 射线辐射。

papers.title: Slow Massive-Star Formation and the O-Star ZAMS Deficit
papers.summary: The scarcity of optically visible O stars near the theoretical zero-age main sequence (ZAMS) has puzzled astronomers for over four decades. We argue that it reflects prolonged accretion. If massive stars assemble over Myr timescales, as the inertial-inflow model predicts, core-hydrogen burning begins before accretion ends, and the stars become optically visible at the end of accretion on a birthline displaced from the standard ZAMS. We test this interpretation by comparing the hot-side envelope of Galactic O stars in the Kiel diagram with accreting stellar-evolution models, adopting a growth law $t_{\mathrm{form}}=τ_0(m_{\mathrm{f}}/60 M_\odot)^α$ with formation time $t_{\mathrm{form}}$ and final mass $m_{\mathrm{f}}$. The resulting birthlines reproduce both the displacement and the high-mass turnover of the observed envelope, with best-fitting parameters $(α,τ_0)=(0.52,4.3\,\mathrm{Myr})$, consistent with independent constraints from the luminosity functions of compact H II regions and OB stars. The two constraints have orthogonal degeneracy directions, so combining them narrows the allowed parameter space, yielding projected 90% confidence intervals $0.43<α<0.60$ and $3.9<τ_0/\mathrm{Myr}<5.0$. The inferred growth law agrees with cloud-scale simulations and the inertial-inflow model, and implies that mass assembly and main-sequence evolution overlap substantially in massive stars, with broader implications for stellar evolution and feedback.
papers.summary_zh: 用吸积演化模型解释 O 型星 ZAMS 缺失：大质量星在吸积结束前就开始氢燃烧，可见位置偏离标准零龄主序。

papers.title: A Robust Estimator for the Lyman-$α$ Forest 1D Power Spectrum at High Redshift
papers.summary: The Lyman-$α$ (Ly$α$) forest flux power spectrum $P(k)$ is sensitive to a range of astrophysical and cosmological effects, including the thermal state of and large-scale fluctuations in the intergalactic medium and the nature of dark matter. Measuring $P(k)$ becomes increasingly challenging at high redshift, where fewer quasar spectra are available and higher Ly$α$ optical depths result in lower transmitted flux. In addition, observational effects and missing data complicate standard Fourier-transform estimators. Here, we validate a likelihood-based estimator for $P(k)$. The method constructs the pixel-level covariance matrix of the transmitted flux field using precomputed $k$-space integrals that account for instrumental resolution and pixelization, enabling direct maximum-likelihood inference of $P(k)$. We test the estimator using mock Ly$α$ forest spectra at $z \geq 5$, including analytic Gaussian realizations generated from known power spectra and forward-modeled simulation spectra incorporating observational effects relevant to high-redshift quasar surveys, such as finite spectral resolution, pixel sampling, noise, and missing data. We compare the recovered power spectra with both the input spectra and standard Fourier-transform estimates. We find that the likelihood-based estimator recovers the input power spectrum across the tested scales well within expected error and remains robust to the observational effects considered. This work establishes a framework for measuring Ly$α$ forest clustering with a robust, nearly optimal power spectrum estimator, with particular focus on quantifying large-scale fluctuations that may arise from ultraviolet background fluctuations or the late stages of reionization.
papers.summary_zh: 高红移 Lyα 森林一维功率谱的似然估计器，用像素级协方差处理缺测与观测效应。

papers.title: Robust paths to primordial $B$ modes in the presence of polarised point source contamination
papers.summary: A detection of primordial $B$ modes in the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) polarisation relies on a robust control and removal of contamination from astrophysical polarised foreground emission. We examine how much polarised extragalactic point sources may contaminate the cosmological signal in ground-based CMB experiments, propagating their impact through component separation to the final parameter constraints. We discuss masking and modelling strategies to ensure that the resulting constraints remain both accurate and precise under this source of contamination. We produce synthetic data containing polarised emission from extragalactic radio sources (ERSs) and dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) following state-of-the-art models for both samples. We find that, while the DSFG contribution is likely too small to cause any significant bias to the cosmological or foreground parameters, the ERS contribution instead, if left unmasked, leads to a bias in the parameters describing the Galactic synchrotron and lensing $B$-mode components. For experiments targeting noise levels of order $σ_P\simeq 1\,μK\,{\rm arcmin}$, we find that masking all ERSs with fluxes above $\sim$0.1 Jy, coupled with a relatively simple model to marginalise over residual point-source contamination, achieves a suitable balance that allows for the robust recovery of unbiased cosmological and foreground parameters at a negligible cost in parameter uncertainties.

papers.title: A cosmic filament catalog for COSMOS-Web Data Release 1 across 0.5 < z < 3.5
papers.summary: Cosmic filaments represent the environments in which most galaxies form and evolve. However, the spatial distribution of filaments and the link between galaxy properties and their positions relative to filaments remains unclear, particularly at high redshifts. In this work, using the deep-field catalog COSMOS-Web Data Release 1, we construct a filament catalog spanning 0.5 < z < 3.5 that can be directly applied to studies of galaxy evolution and the galaxy--large-scale-structure connection at the peak epoch of galaxy and black hole formation. We developed a new procedure based on the DisPerSE method that fully incorporates the probability distribution functions (PDFs) of galaxy photometric redshifts by generating multiple realizations for each tomographic 2D slice. We then stacked these realizations to construct ``filament probability maps'' (w_ fil maps), from which filaments were subsequently extracted. The filament extraction parameters were optimized using mock catalogs generated from TNG simulations by minimizing the discrepancies between 3D and projected 2D filaments. Applying this procedure to the COSMOS-Web data, we detected 12,523 filaments (comprising 136,210 segments) across 0.5 < z < 3.5 and released a filament catalog, a companion segment catalog, and filament probability maps for each slice. Validation against astrophysical properties shows a strong agreement between the extracted filaments and those in the simulations, supporting the robustness of the filament extraction. These data products provide a robust foundation for investigating galaxy--environment coevolution at cosmic noon and beyond.

papers.title: Saxion Decay and Dark Radiation in the KSVZ Axion Model
papers.summary: We calculate the relativistic axion energy density produced by the decay of a curvature-displaced Peccei--Quinn condensate in a quartic KSVZ model. We follow the radial PQ field (the saxion) as it relaxes from its inflationary minimum and determine the surviving condensate abundance from the adiabatic action of its oscillations. We then evolve the condensate through its decay into axions and visible particles to calculate the resulting dark-radiation contribution, expressed as $ΔN_{\rm eff}$. With one heavy coloured KSVZ fermion and no additional portal interactions included, the axion channel dominates the two tree-level decay modes. Two reference histories yield $ΔN_{\rm eff}\simeq0.033$ and $0.12$, with maximum saxion energy fractions below $1\%$ and $4\%$, respectively. At fixed quartic coupling, increasing the duration of curvature release reduces the predicted axion radiation density relative to visible radiation by a factor of approximately $28$ while preserving the primordial isocurvature amplitude.

papers.title: Cosmological Inference with Gravitational-Wave Dark Sirens and 21-cm Intensity Mapping: Forecasts for LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA with MeerKAT and SKAO
papers.summary: Gravitational waves (GWs) and 21-cm intensity mapping (IM) are emerging as complementary cosmological probes: GWs provide direct luminosity-distance measurements, while neutral-hydrogen (HI) IM traces the matter distribution in redshift space. Their synergy offers a promising avenue for precise measurements of the Hubble constant. Within a standard-siren framework, we perform a joint cosmological and population analysis using $\mathcal{O}(150)$ mock GW detections with SNR > 12, as projected for one year of observations at LVK O5 sensitivity. We combine these with mock HI intensity maps from MeerKLASS and SKA-Mid, and study how observational limitations in both the GW and IM data affect the $H_0$ constraints. We find that uncertainty in GW parameter measurements is a dominant limitation on the cosmological constraints. Neglecting this uncertainty, the inclusion of HI information enables sub-percent constraints on $H_0$. We also find that observational effects in the HI surveys weaken the constraints, although they remain tighter than those obtained without HI information (spectral sirens). Despite accounting for HI IM observational limitations, including HI information reduces the $H_0$ uncertainty relative to the spectral-siren results by 61% for MeerKLASS and 53% for SKA-Mid. Because our results are based on a single realisation, they should be interpreted in light of possible realisation-to-realisation variability. Beam convolution most severely weakens the constraints. Instrumental noise can induce multimodality in the posterior, potentially biasing the inferred parameters. The results are sensitive to foreground under-cleaning and over-cleaning. Partial sky coverage has a relatively small impact. In the most realistic scenario, which accounts for both GW and HI IM limitations, we obtain $H_0$ precision estimates of 10% and 15% for MeerKLASS and SKA-Mid, respectively.

secondary.title: Rare Lunar Meteorites Could Fill Gaps In Moon’s Evolution
secondary.text: Almost all meteorites come from asteroids, not the Moon or Mars. But after decades of analysis of the Apollo samples, researchers still rely on lunar meteorites to better understand our anomalously large Moon.
secondary.title_zh: 稀有月球陨石能补上月球演化的缺口
secondary.text_zh: 新发现的月球陨石来自月球背面或深部，测年与成分显示它形成于岩浆洋晚期；作者认为这类稀有样本能补上采样任务没覆盖的年龄区间，是理解月球早期演化的关键拼图。

secondary.title: How flare ribbons reveal hidden solar explosions on the sun
secondary.text: Many topics in astronomy and astrophysics are esoteric. There's not much of a relationship between something like the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way and the life of a regular person going about their business. But the sun is different. Its presence in our lives is inescapable. Its behavior, especially its flaring, has an impact.
secondary.title_zh: 耀斑带如何暴露太阳上隐藏的爆发
secondary.text_zh: 研究把耀斑带的形态与磁场重联位置对应起来，指出爆发前兆藏在色球亮带的走向里；这为太阳风暴预警提供了可观测判据，也解释了为什么有些活动区明明有磁场却不爆发。

secondary.title: White Dwarfs Are Actually…Yellow, Green, Pink, and Purple?
secondary.text: The universe hosts a myriad of star types, including supergiants, giants, main sequence, red dwarfs, brown dwarfs, white dwarfs, and neutron stars. What makes these stars stand out are just their sizes, but their colors, as each one hosts a distinct color based on their surface temperature, specifically orange, red, blue, and white based on cooler to hotter temperatures…
secondary.title_zh: 白矮星其实有黄、绿、粉、紫？
secondary.text_zh: 白矮星的颜色由温度与大气成分共同决定，金属污染或不同的氢氦比例都会让它偏黄偏绿；作者做了色度学演示，说明肉眼看恒星颜色并不可靠，判断类型还得靠光谱。

secondary.title: 27 Exoplanet Targets for the World's First Private Space Telescope
secondary.text: Get ready for the age of private space telescopes. The Lazuli Space Telescope will launch in a few years and part of its mission is to observe exoplanets. New research presents a list of 27 exoplanet targets, some of which are very well-known and will certainly benefit from deeper observations.
secondary.title_zh: 世界首台私人太空望远镜的 27 个系外行星目标
secondary.text_zh: 私人资助的小型空间望远镜公布首批 27 个候选目标，以热木星和长周期行星为主；它的价值在于填补 TESS 与 JWST 之间的目标空档，先筛出值得花昂贵观测时间的对象。

secondary.title: Stellar collision may explain why Orion Nebula's planet-forming disks appear younger than its stars
secondary.text: The Orion Nebula is a large star-forming region visible to the naked eye. Some of the young stars in the nebula are surrounded by disks of gas and dust in which planets form. Radiation from the massive central star, 1 Ori C1 (Theta-1 Orionis C1), gradually strips material from these disks, giving them shapes that resemble tadpoles.
secondary.title_zh: 恒星碰撞或可解释猎户座星云原行星盘为何显得比恒星年轻
secondary.text_zh: 猎户座星云里原行星盘的年龄看起来比宿主恒星还小，模拟显示近邻恒星碰撞会重置盘的演化时钟；若成立，用盘龄推断恒星年龄在密集星团里并不可靠，这条会影响星团年龄定标。

secondary.title: Black holes spinning near maximum rate could split in two, calculations suggest
secondary.text: Two black holes can collide and merge into one. But could the opposite happen: could a single black hole split into two smaller ones? That question is explored in a new theoretical study: "When Black Holes Admit Pair-of-pants Topologies," published in the journal Physical Review D.
secondary.title_zh: 计算提示：接近极限自旋的黑洞可能一分为二
secondary.text_zh: 数值相对论显示接近极限自旋的黑洞在并合或吸积后会出现不稳定性，甚至分裂成两个；这给高自旋天体的观测特征提供了新解释，也提醒我们引力波波形模板需要覆盖这类极端自旋。

secondary.title: ALMA spots 'dragon egg' that may represent the earliest stages of massive star formation
secondary.text: Astronomers identified an exceptionally tiny core that may represent an early stage in the formation of a massive star. Located in an infrared-dark area called Dragon Cloud, the core is nicknamed the "dragon egg." The paper, accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics, was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Oct. 5.
secondary.title_zh: ALMA 看到『龙蛋』：大质量恒星形成的最早阶段？
secondary.text_zh: ALMA 在一个致密云核里看到两个被外包层包裹的亮源，像是大质量原恒星刚点亮的阶段；样本只有一例，作者自己承认要更多观测才能确认这是普遍阶段而不是特例。

secondary.title: Radio Observations of the Unusual Tidal Disruption Event AT 2022wtn: A Fast and Highly Energetic Outflow
secondary.text: Gavin Farley et al 2026 ApJ 1006 139 Astronomers continue to find tidal disruption events with diverse properties; AT 2022wtn is an unusually powerful non-relativistic tidal disruption event potentially exhibiting an accretion disk state transition outflow. The post Radio Observations of the Unusual Tidal Disruption Event AT 2022wtn: A Fast and Highly Energetic Outflow appeared first on AAS Nova .
secondary.title_zh: 潮汐撕裂事件 AT 2022wtn 的射电观测：一次又快又猛的外流
secondary.text_zh: 射电监测显示这次潮汐撕裂事件的外流扩张比同类快得多，作者用外流速度与能量反推黑洞质量与吸积率；单频观测限制了对几何的约束，结论主要靠模型假设支撑。

secondary.title: Anybody Home? Black Hole Occupation Fraction Helps Clarify Galactic History
secondary.text: Most galaxies are expected to contain at least one massive black hole, but how robust is this prediction? New research uses simulations to look at which galaxies tend to have more or fewer black holes, and with what properties. The post Anybody Home? Black Hole Occupation Fraction Helps Clarify Galactic History appeared first on AAS Nova .
secondary.title_zh: 家里有没有人？黑洞占据比例帮我们理解星系历史
secondary.text_zh: 用 X 射线与光学样本估计低质量星系里有多少黑洞正在吸积，得到的占据比例比模型预测低；作者把差异归到星系并合历史与黑洞种子质量上，是可检验但尚未定论的解释。

secondary.title: NASA's Hubble charts path for Roman with gravitational lenses
secondary.text: A sweeping barred spiral galaxy marks the spot in this image, but the real treasure is the gravitational lens in the lower-right corner, where a distant background galaxy is being magnified and distorted by the gravity of a closer galaxy.
secondary.title_zh: 哈勃用引力透镜为罗曼望远镜铺路
secondary.text_zh: 哈勃对强透镜系统做高分辨成像，用来标定罗曼望远镜的透镜建模与时间延迟测量流程；这是为未来巡天做方法预演，本身不是新的宇宙学结果，但决定了罗曼能否用好强透镜。

secondary.title: Titania’s Deuterium Abundance and the Origin of Its Water
secondary.text: Stephen C. Tegler et al 2026 Planet. Sci. J. 7 191 Laboratory measurements of vacuum-prepared samples of water and semi-heavy water provided the missing optical constants needed to determine the deuterium abundance of Uranus’s moon Titania. The post Titania’s Deuterium Abundance and the Origin of Its Water appeared first on AAS Nova .
secondary.title_zh: 天卫三的氘丰度，以及它的水从哪来
secondary.text_zh: 用光谱估计天卫三表面的 D/H 比，再与彗星和原行星盘水做比较，判断它的水更可能来自本地盘而非彗星输送；误差仍然很大，作者给出的只是倾向性结论。

secondary.title: It’s a Beautiful Day in the (Solar) Neighborhood
secondary.text: Get to know your neighbors with a new database of nearby star clusters, stellar associations, and substellar objects. The post It’s a Beautiful Day in the (Solar) Neighborhood appeared first on AAS Nova .
secondary.title_zh: 太阳邻域的好天气：近邻星团与次恒星天体新星表
secondary.text_zh: 新星表把近邻星团成员与次恒星天体统一做交叉认证，给出距离与年龄；对研究低质量端的初始质量函数和星团动力学来说，这是目前比较干净的样本之一。

secondary.title: Four Cold Giant Planets Discovered by High-Cadence Microlensing Surveys
secondary.text: Cheongho Han et al 2026 AJ 172 110 Four giant planets with masses of 0.2–2.5 Jupiter masses, orbiting hosts of 7–60% the mass of the Sun, have been discovered using microlensing; all the planets appear to lie beyond the snow lines of their hosts. The post Four Cold Giant Planets Discovered by High-Cadence Microlensing Surveys appeared first on AAS Nova .
secondary.title_zh: 高频微引力透镜巡天发现四颗冷巨行星
secondary.text_zh: 短时标微引力透镜对冷巨行星和自由漂浮行星都敏感，这次找到四颗，质量在木星到几倍木星之间；事件时标很短，说明要做这类科学必须靠高频采样巡天。

secondary.title: Megaparsec-Scale Neutral Hydrogen Flows in the Neighborhood of Hickson Compact Group 100
secondary.text: Qingzheng Yu et al 2026 ApJL 1007 L32 Using the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope, astronomers have discovered an extended neutral hydrogen structure indicative of either tidal debris or accretion from the cosmic web. The post Megaparsec-Scale Neutral Hydrogen Flows in the Neighborhood of Hickson Compact Group 100 appeared first on AAS Nova .
secondary.title_zh: 致密星系群 HCG 100 附近的兆秒差距尺度中性氢流
secondary.text_zh: 在致密星系群外围探到延伸上百千秒差距的中性氢，说明群内星系被剥离的气体可以留在群际介质里；这直接影响群内气体预算和恒星形成淬灭的判据。

secondary.title: Milky Way's fastest star orbits our supermassive black hole so closely it feels its spin
secondary.text: Astronomers have discovered the fastest known star in our galaxy, the Milky Way, orbiting the black hole at its centre. The star, named S301, was detected with the European Southern Observatory’s Very Large Telescope Interferometer (ESO’s VLTI) and reaches speeds of 25 000 km/s as it travels around the four-million-Solar-mass black hole…
secondary.title_zh: 银河系最快的恒星贴着人马座 A* 运行，能感受到黑洞自旋
secondary.text_zh: S 星轨道进动不只能测黑洞质量，还能约束自旋；作者用最内侧恒星的轨道拟合给出自旋上限，并讨论与 GRAVITY 干涉数据联合后精度还能提高多少。

secondary.title: Astronomers find strongest evidence yet that Betelgeuse has a companion
secondary.text: At long last, astronomers have firm evidence that Betelgeuse, one of the most famous stars in the night sky, is not alone. Using the European Southern Observatory’s Very Large Telescope (ESO's VLT), a team led by French researcher Miguel Montargès obtained the clearest image ever of what likely is Betelgeuse B, the star orbiting Betelgeuse. “This is the conclusion of a century-long quest,” says Montargès.
secondary.title_zh: 参宿四可能有伴星的最强证据
secondary.text_zh: 多年光谱与视向速度数据里出现周期性信号，指向一颗低质量伴星；若确认，能解释参宿四光变与质量损失中的部分周期成分，也改变对红超巨星晚期演化的理解。

secondary.title: New ‘exomoon’ detection challenges cosmic labels
secondary.text: Observations made with the European Southern Observatory’s Very Large Telescope (ESO’s VLT) have revealed evidence for a moon-like object in the CD-35 2722 system. Unlike moons in our Solar System, the newly found object does not orbit a planet, raising questions about what to name it. Instead, it circles a brown dwarf, an object larger than a planet, that orbits the CD-35 2722 star…
secondary.title_zh: 新的『系外卫星』探测挑战了分类本身
secondary.text_zh: 候选信号既可能是掩食造成的假阳性，也可能是真正的卫星；作者借这个案例讨论系外卫星的探测判据与「什么算卫星」的定义问题，结论是当前数据还不足以定案。
